outputs.explanation: Main panel is a scatter plot where each of the 141 samples is plotted individually (points are the data); marginal histograms depict raw distributions rather than means with error bars. Scatter plots and histograms are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
This is a scatter plot (each cell line/reporter shown as a distinct marker with error bars); scatter plots are exempt from the requirement to overlay individual data points.
Smooth density/line curves showing distributions of period and amplitude per subtype; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-point overlay requirement.
Box plots of ridge lengths, which are exempt by type, and individual data points (colored dots for Per2-Luc/Bmal1-Luc) are additionally overlaid on the boxes.
Polar histograms showing probability distributions of phase differences per cell line; histogram-type distribution plots are exempt from the individual-point overlay requirement.
Polar histogram showing subtype-averaged phase-difference distribution; histogram-type plots are exempt from the individual-point overlay requirement.
Line plot of a single example signal with its fitted curve and an illustrative decay envelope; line plots (and illustrative schematic traces) are exempt from the requirement.
Scatter plot in which each of the 117 individual samples is plotted as its own point (with fit-uncertainty error bars); scatter plots are exempt from the individual-point overlay requirement.
